title: Pokemon Larvesta 196/191 Shiny Rare Surging Sparks Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokemon TCG - Larvesta, Shiny Rare, card 196/191

Scarlet & Violet series set SV08 Surging Sparks (Shiny Vault). Basic, Fire type. HP 70.

Attacks: Ram (10 damage), Steady Firebreathing (20 damage)
Illustrator: Whitsker

Ungraded, raw single. Condition: pulled and sleeved immediately, handled by the edges. Front and back are both photographed - please judge corners, edges, surface and centering for yourself from the images, as they are of the actual card you will receive.

Shipping: Penny sleeve into a top loader, inside a bubble mailer with cardboard backing. Combined shipping on multiple purchases - just ask before paying.
